A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 15-page versions of ReconDreamer++. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, references and supplementary Sections 6–7 support direct comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original ReconDreamer++ evaluations on Waymo, nuScenes, PandaSet and EUVS in Tables 1–4, component ablations in Table 5, and qualitative results including supplementary Figures 5–7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, component ablations and qualitative results in the main text and supplementary material.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.5 retain the same scene decomposition, ground model, NTDNet, depth supervision and optimization procedure. No algorithmic component or model behavior changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four datasets and original and novel trajectories, including the same lateral shifts and PandaSet vertical-shift scenario. Supplementary dataset coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within every experiment: FreeVS, Street Gaussians, DriveDreamer4D with PVG and ReconDreamer on Waymo; Street Gaussians and ReconDreamer on nuScenes/EUVS; and UniSim, NeuRAD, Street Gaussians and ReconDreamer on PandaSet.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and 6 retain the same scene selections, trajectory shifts, metrics, training budget, FreeVS image cropping and EUVS foreground masking. No reported protocol revision accompanies the changed scores.

E4.justification: The depth-loss, ground-model and NTDNet ablations in Section 4.3, Table 5 and Figure 4 are unchanged. Supplementary qualitative comparisons in Section 7 and Figures 5–7 also match.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 1 changes FreeVS's Waymo NTL-IoU from 53.26 to 56.84 at a 3 m lane shift and from 53.08 to 55.37 at 6 m. FreeVS moves ahead of ReconDreamer at 3 m and approaches ReconDreamer++, whose scores remain 57.06 and 56.57. All other numerical and qualitative results match.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(7), including Gaussian parameterization, coordinate transformations, NTDNet updates and loss definitions, are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises formal assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and superiority claims concerning domain-gap mitigation, ground modeling and original/novel trajectory rendering. Headline improvements over ReconDreamer are unchanged.

C2.justification: Explanations of domain-gap effects, geometric consistency and component contributions remain identical, as do applicability qualifications in the supplementary material. No revised interpretation or limitation accompanies the FreeVS score changes.

D1.justification: Both versions disclose the same 50,000 training steps, eight-layer MLPs with hidden dimension 256, scene identifiers, metric implementations, project-page link and supplementary video-folder reference. No implementation or resource-access information changes.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 63 references are unchanged. Positioning relative to ReconDreamer, DriveDreamer4D and other reconstruction or generative approaches remains identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 24 March 2025 to v2 dated 10 July 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–6 retain their placement, captions, formatting and structure. Table 1 changes only two numerical entries; the updated marginal version stamp causes no reflow of the paper.

improvement.justification: The only scientific revisions are two higher FreeVS scores in Table 1, narrowing ReconDreamer++'s reported advantage while preserving its lead. Neither PDF explains or validates these replacements, so improved reporting accuracy cannot be established. With methods, analyses, exposition and supplementary material otherwise unchanged, the net effect on paper quality is uncertain.
